narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Operator discovery for the SCM label mirror stack (#1423 Waves 1-2). Defaults are ON but consumers only learn via CHANGELOG. Discovery must teach existence plus get-the-most-out-of-it: dry-run, defaults only stamp triaged on matches, board usability needs actionLabels, match rate needs triageAutoClassify, never auto-accept.

## Scheduling / dependency

Wave 2 (#3125 / #3126) and consumer kit (#2611) are done. Implement discovery packaging.

## Acceptance criteria

- Throttled operator-facing discovery tip (cold session:start / triage:welcome; not every re-arm)
- Tip states dry-run + apply boundary + never auto-accept
- Tip teaches get-the-most: defaults=triaged control stamp; board usability requires actionLabels (full five-chip map); triageAutoClassify for match rate; policy:show + PROJECT-DEFINITION; GitHub labels must exist; re-enrich warning; point at consumer kit #2611
- Dry-run digest SHOULD hint when actionLabels empty or open no_match dominates
- Agent anti-swallow requires user-visible restatement when tip fires
- Docs pointer (commands.md); CHANGELOG Unreleased; unit tests for throttle and tip content

## Non-goals

- Auto-apply / auto-accept
- Wave 3 agent comments
- Classify engine work
- Full #1789 area vocabulary
narratives.Labels: enhancement, triage, agent-experience, process, status:child, triaged, triage:deferred
narratives.UserStory: As a project operator, I want session and triage surfaces to disclose SCM label mirror with upgrade path guidance, so that I can dry-run and configure actionLabels and triageAutoClassify instead of only learning that a flag exists.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add throttled operator-facing discovery tip on session:start and/or triage:welcome/doctor (not every re-arm).
2. Tip content MUST include dry-run command, apply boundary, never auto-accept, defaults=triaged on match only, actionLabels board usability cliff, triageAutoClassify match rate, policy:show and PROJECT-DEFINITION location, pointer to #2611 kit.
3. Dry-run digest SHOULD hint when actionLabels empty or open no_match dominates.
4. Agent anti-swallow rule requires user-visible restatement of existence + get-the-most when tip fires.
5. Docs pointer in commands.md; CHANGELOG; tests for throttle and tip content.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a cold mutation session or triage welcome, when discovery is due, then a short tip surfaces once until ack or first successful dry-run and does not spam every re-arm.

Given the tip fires, when the operator reads it, then it states dry-run and apply boundary, defaults only stamp triaged on matches, board usability requires actionLabels, more matches need triageAutoClassify, never auto-accept, and policy:show / PROJECT-DEFINITION location with full five-chip map recommendation.
Given dry-run planned actions with empty actionLabels or open no_match domination, when the digest prints, then a footer hint points at actionLabels or triageAutoClassify respectively.

Given the tip fires, when an agent continues the session, then agent-facing guidance requires restating existence plus customization path in the user-visible message, not only absorbing ritual output.
Given discovery ships, when docs and tests run, then commands.md has a depth pointer, CHANGELOG has an Unreleased entry, and unit tests cover throttle and required tip content.
